bullets: Easy Installation & Quality Design: Hassle-Free Setup and made with durable materials and designed to last, the THIRDREALITY Multi-Function Night Light promises long-term service. It is simple and elegant, fitting seamlessly into any decor style. Adapter already included.

Convenient and Practical: THIRDREALIY smart night light provides ultimate convenience. Whether it's for a late-night visit to the bathroom or simply providing a soothing light for a child's room, it responds quickly to movements and changes in light intensity. Perfect for use in various spaces including bedrooms, bathrooms, hallways, and baby rooms. It also works great as a decoration light for festivals and parties.

Versatile Lighting Modes: Depending on your preference or mood, you can choose from an array of different light colors. It also supports 1% to 100% adjustable brightness. From a soft, calming blue to a bright, energizing green, the night light offers an impressive spectrum of color and brightness choices.

Similarly, its light sensor can be used to activate other smart home devices when the surrounding light intensity changes.

bullets: Attention: Not compatible with third-party Zigbee devices or generic smart home systems.

Expand Coverage – The LinkTap Extender creates a powerful self-healing mesh network to enhance your smart irrigation system, ensuring stable connectivity for large gardens and challenging terrains.
Weatherproof & Durable – Built to withstand indoor and outdoor conditions (IP66-rated), the LinkTap Extender ensures year-round reliability, no matter the weather.
Versatile Power Options – Power the LinkTap Extender with the included AC-DC adapter, a solar panel with rechargeable batteries, or any 5-12V DC input (e.g., garden light power).
Plug-and-Play Installation – No wiring or technical skills needed. Integrate into your automated irrigation setup within minutes via the LinkTap app.
